hypothesis: Adversarial training of generative models against discriminative models improves output quality
prediction: Generated images will have a higher sharpness metric
units_range: 0-1 (sharpness metric, e.g. clarity or variance of Laplacian)
measurement_method: Evaluate generated images using a sharpness metric (e.g. clarity or variance of Laplacian) and compare to baseline generative models without adversarial training
falsification_condition: If the sharpness metric of generated images does not increase by at least 10% compared to the baseline, or if the generated images are not visually more realistic and detailed, then the prediction is falsified.
